options.name: addresses
options.description: IP addresses to add/remove in IPv4 format.

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: esxi_credentials
options.description: Credentials required for re-registering the ESXi hosts in the vCenter. It should be passed only when ESXi host addresses or management network VLAN / prefix / gateway are changed during the reconfiguration of the PowerStore X model appliances. This parameter is applicable only for PowerStore X model. This parameter will be ignored if passed for PowerStore T model.

options.name: gateway
options.description: Network gateway in IPv4 format. IP version. Specify empty string to remove the gateway.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) packet size set on network interfaces, in bytes.

options.name: network_id
options.description: The ID of the network.

options.name: network_name
options.description: The name of the network. This parameter is added in 2.0.0.0. Specify either I(network_name) or I(network_id) for any operation.

options.name: new_cluster_mgmt_address
options.description: New cluster management IP address in IPv4 format.

options.name: new_name
options.description: New name of the network.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: port_state
options.description: Specifies whether port should mapped/unmapped from the storage network.

options.name: ports
options.description: Ports to be mapped/unmapped to/from the storage network.

options.name: prefix_length
options.description: Network prefix length.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the network exist or not.

options.name: storage_discovery_address
options.description: New storage discovery IP address in IPv4 format. Specify empty string to remove the storage discovery IP address.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vasa_provider_credentials
options.description: Credentials required for re-registering the VASA vendor provider during the reconfiguration of the cluster management IP address.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: The ID of the VLAN.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: Flag to indicate if the operation should be run synchronously or asynchronously. C(true) signifies synchronous execution. By default, modify operation will run C(asynchronously).
